title: KTR | Kayaba Tools Refabricated
description: Inspired by classic anime, internet culture, and real science, it brings a colorful mix of powerful weapons, iconic sounds, and useful materials to the game.
body:
# Mod Overview: Steel, Vampirism, and Chemistry
## This mod adds technical materials, a blood mechanic, new crops, and a system for crafting beverages to the game.

### 1. Materials and Metallurgy
**Steel**
- Ingot
- Rod
- Block

**Bloody**
- Steel Ingot
- Block Iron Block


### Weapons:
- Steel Sword
- Refined Steel Sword
- Ancient Sword
- Devil Sword: Can be strengthened using filled blood syringes.
- Cosmic Sword

![Things](https://i.imgur.com/fMuyTWc.png)

### 2. Vampirism Mechanics
- Syringe: Used to extract blood from the player themselves.
- Bloody Altar: Station for performing blood-based upgrades on the Devil Sword.


### 3. Warden Interaction
- Warden Capturing Tool
- Captured Warden (can place the Warden wherever you want)


### 4. Agriculture and Chemistry (Cola Production)
**Crops**
- Lime
- Coriander

**Chemicals**
- Sulfuric Acid
- Nitric Acid (both used for gunpowder crafting)

![Cola Drink](https://i.imgur.com/FYS9NG1.png)

**Ingredients**
- Dark honey
- caramelized honey
- carbonated water


### Processing:
Production of cola syrup from the basic ingredients (lime, coriander and honey).
Mixing the syrup with carbonated water to make the finished cola drink.

Translated with DeepL.com
